title: Multidimensional poverty in India
definition: The share of India's population experiencing multiple simultaneous deprivations across 12 indicators in health, education and standard of living under the NITI Aayog National MPI.

sources.title: Multidimensional Poverty in India since 2005-06 (Discussion Paper)

points.evidence: Page 3, Table 1: India Headcount Ratio (H)% for 2005-06 (NFHS-3) is 55.34.

points.estimate_method: Interpolated by NITI Aayog between NFHS-3 (2005-06) and NFHS-4 (2015-16) using the compound annual rate of reduction.
